doc_friction.issue: No guidance on solve cost: 11,442 cold-start subset solves took 2 h on 4 cores (3-view sets often hit the 2,000-evaluation cap); a per-solve timing note for sensing-selfcal would have let the plan size the run before starting

Board pattern is a module global baked into default arguments (board_points, planarity) and robust_sf; reusing the solver on another board needs monkeypatching or a private module copy. A pattern argument threaded through would be cleaner

deviations.why: The first pre-registered view-selection rule (sharpest frame per time block) picked 7-8 px boards and fronto-parallel views; replaced before any solve, looking only at corner spacing and a contact sheet
deviations.did: Added a 15 px spacing floor and a foreshortening criterion; documented in prepare.py and the LOG plan, which was committed before results
deviations.result: 13 well-spread views per unit; the change is disclosed

deviations.why: Milestone 4i's H59 check used 8 sets per size, 3 noise configs, 9,600 solves (25 min); with 4 cores busy for 2 h on the main solves, the replication was cut to iid noise and 4 sets per size
deviations.did: Pre-registered the smaller check (1,280 solves) in the plan
deviations.result: Enough to refute H64 on fr1 (cold-start far minima); fr3 matches within 0.4%

writeups: research/sensing-selfcal/paper/draft.md (Section 7 two-unit paragraph, recommendations 2 and 5, limitations, Section 10)
goal: Advance the open sensing-selfcal programme: the paper's first listed submission need (the twin reference on a second unit)
notes: Data: TUM RGB-D (CC BY 4.0) fr1_rgb_calibration and fr3_calibration_rgb_depth downloaded through the proxy (cvg.cit.tum.de works, ~1 min per GB); only corners committed (a person is in every frame). Results: H63 held (fr3 f within 0.64% of TUM); H64 refuted on fr1 (cold-start far minima at n=7, one never-converging 4-view set); H65 refuted at k=4 only (3.3%/4.7%; 0.06-0.80% at k=5-6); H66 refuted (10.0% at +-2%, k=6, vs 33.1% on OpenCV); H67 refuted (real unit difference only 1.40% after fr1's k1-only bias; caught 6.3%/7.9%, between the +-1% and +-2% scaled rates). Verification: tests/test_m4j.py + test_m4i.py + test_selfcal.py pass together (31); paper/check_numbers.py 175/175; build.py ok; check_md_links ok; cite_check ok for the TUM DOI; analyse.py and check.py rerun after the module-isolation fix gave a byte-identical summary.json and a check.json equal to the 16th significant digit (pool order).
